senses.gloss: āchoḍita (?), ppp. (for āchorita, cf. Skt. āchurita, KSS, scratched, drawn?), set, inlaid (with strings of jewels): SP 〔151.9〕 (prose) suvarṇasūtrāchoḍitaṃ (buddhakṣetraṃ). So both edd., but with only 1 ms. (KN); the others ˚āchāditaṃ covered. However, Tib. bris pa (acc. to WT), scratched, drawn, inscribed (if connected with ḥbri ba), would seem to support this reading.
